Daily Receipt integration
Source: https://github.com/shengyuanshi/daily-receipt-opensource
Copyright (c) 2026 Daily Receipt contributors
License: MIT (see daily-receipt-MIT.txt)

Adapted parts: paper texture, receipt tear polygon, print-out and settling animation approach.
Reused asset: src/assets/metal-receipt-tray.png -> assets/receipt-tray.png.
The family medicine UI and medicine fields are custom. No user caches, authentication
files, personal receipts, environment variables or backend integrations were copied.
